name: Omadoist
author: Martin Bjærge Jensen
description: Todoist in the Omarchy bar and menu: the open-task count next to the Todoist mark, a panel that lists your tasks and ticks them off in place, inline add and filter, and notifications only for changes made elsewhere.

barWidget.description: Open-task count in the bar; click for the list. Enter completes, n adds, r refreshes, o opens Todoist.

schema.label: Hide when there are no open tasks
Bar glyph
schema.description: The Todoist mark from the bundled font. Any Nerd Font glyph works once the font below is cleared.

schema.label: Glyph font family
schema.description: Leave empty to draw the glyph with the bar font.

schema.label: omadoist launcher
schema.description: Defaults to bin/omadoist inside the plugin folder.
